articles.title: US seeks to bridge gaps at first Russia-Ukraine peace talks in nine months
articles.description: By Roula RouhanaABU DHABI, Nov 10 (Reuters) - Russian and Ukrainian officials met in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday for their first peace talks since February as US President Donald Trump's envoys launched a new push to end the war in Ukraine.The US-brokered meeting followed US contacts with both sides in recent weeks that Trump's representative Jared Kushner said had narrowed the gaps between their positions.Addressing delegates at the start of the meeting, Kushner said the United States had some good ideas on how to make progress, and Trump was committed to achieving peace.
